fact: UNESCO handed over an AI-powered multi-hazard chatbot to Ghana's National Disaster Management Organization (NADMO) on 26 May 2026, now owned and run by the agency, answering public questions on seven hazards and delivering automated responses during emergencies in several languages.
NCA Deputy Director-General Salifu Suleman said AI is increasingly becoming an integral tool in the NCA's processes and activities.

Ghana Statistical Service has built a machine-learning model that suggests occupation and industry codes for its labour force survey, automatically accepting confident codes and sending the rest to an official whose corrections retrain it, replacing hand coding of 27,467 workers in one 2025 quarter.
